message.text: Taken: one Sonnet minion, working in three steps. First it finds the reload path the last fix missed. Then it puts each transcription update straight into the text area and drops the italic div. Last, sending clears the text area while the mic keeps going, and the sent text becomes its own chat bubble. I'll report when it lands.

Landed, live and uncommitted. The reload check only watched the "listening" state, so it missed the moments before it (a new card's autostart is the likeliest one that hit you), the 400 ms device reopen, and a sentence still being posted. It now covers all of those. Whisper now types straight into the text area with no italic div. Sending clears it while the mic keeps going, and pauses become paragraph breaks with ah/um/uh cut. I only tested this headless, not with a real microphone.
